messages:
anne: quick sync — thinking about a new pricing add-on to reduce support noise from bursty customers. idea: a `surge-protection` add-on that auto-credits short spikes, enforces soft caps, and gives a 1h circuit-breaker before reclaiming. would help self-serve churn and avoid painful contract renegotiations. thoughts?

sam: sounds promising. key Q: how does this interact with Reserved/Dedicated offers? we need deterministic SLAs for enterprise.

maria: +1. for self-serve this can be opt-in, maybe free trial for first 7 days. for enterprise we can expose as a configurable policy in contracts (on/off, cap threshold, cost multiplier).

prateek: want concrete numbers before we present to sales. proposal sketch:
```yaml
surge_protection:
  window: 60m
  free_credits: 500k_tokens
  soft_limit: 200% of committed_rps
  reconnect_backoff: 1h
  surcharge_rate: 1.5x
```
that keeps billing simple.

liz: UX note — Console needs a clear indicator + audit trail. customers will ask "who triggered credits" and "how many remaining". add a per-customer telemetry card to the rollout.

ben: legal/contract constraints: can't auto-bill without explicit consent in some regions. for enterprise, we should add an opt-in clause and a monthly reconciliation statement. also need to tie to commit floors so we don't erode contracted ARR.

anne: agreed on consent. launch criteria I'm proposing: 1) pilot with 5 customers (mix self-serve + enterprise) 2) <3% billing disputes after 30 days 3) telemetry shows reduced support ticket rate for quota spikes by 40% 4) no SLA regressions for Dedicated.

sam: rollout plan: phase 0 = internal testing on staging; phase 1 = pilot with 5 customers; phase 2 = self-serve toggle + docs; phase 3 = GA. timeline? 8–10 weeks if we parallelize.

maria: dependents: Console card (liz), billing reconciliation export (finance), contract language template (legal), knob in Dedicated control plane (infra).

prateek: product risks: customers might game the system. mitigation: add abuse detection (spikes with no previous pattern get flagged and require approval). metric: >90% legitimate spikes pass auto-crediting.

ben: ops ask — we need a fallback policy when capacity is exhausted: auto-fallback to lower-cost model variant + notice. include in spec.

anne: action items: @liz doc console mockups by EOW, @prateek draft abuse rules, @ben loop legal/finance for contract text, @sam schedule pilot customers. I'll draft the spec PR.

deploy-bot: reminder: create a feature flag `surge_protection_v1` for controlled rollout.

maria: one more: pricing sheet add-on name suggestion: "Surge Guard". simple and clear. :shield:

anne: love it — ok let's move forward with that name for the pilot. I'll open the spec and assign owners. Thanks all!
